WHY STITCHES EXISTS

Clothing is a collection of decisions.
Let’s make them visible.

A finished garment is only the beginning. The pieces, fabric, fit and order of construction determine what you can actually make. Stitches is being built to keep those relationships connected — and help you learn as you go.
